notes.1: user_id, item_id and prediction_date define the sample key and are not model features
notes.2: the prediction target is whether the user purchases the item on the next calendar day
notes.3: category_id is excluded as a raw integer identifier; category aggregate features remain
notes.4: raw datetime columns are excluded because engineered recency/hour/span features already exist
notes.5: categorical fields use fixed one-hot encoding
notes.6: recent behavior sequence is converted into position features and behavior counts
